description: Sets an end user's ban state, at once, with no save; "none" lifts any state. banned: cannot play, sees the ban message and can still write to you. terminated: blocked, device sealed ("none" reopens it). community_muted: plays and reports but cannot publish, rate or review. Fires the `ban` webhook; banned and terminated users' community votes stop counting. Stores no reason (neblla_send_communication can tell the user why). More: neblla_get_llms tools/set_ban_status

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

userId.description: The user's `_id` from neblla_list_users, not an email.

name: neblla_set_ban_status
title: Ban or unban a user
